texts.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从[abduction_planet.System.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，俘获了数名活体外星人，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of darkness and seize several live aliens, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that is sure to help us decode their language and assess their technological level.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

texts.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从[abduction_planet.System.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，然后却惊奇地发现这里的居民实际上是机械体无人机。不管怎样，他们在无伤条件下捕获了数台无人机，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of darkness and were surprised to discover that the inhabitants were, in fact, mechanical drones. Nevertheless, they seized several of them undamaged, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that is sure to help us decode their language and assess their technological level.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

texts.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，降落在了一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。他们设法降落在了行星上的一个人迹罕至的地方，然后在脱逃之前活捉了几个外星人，同时还顺手牵羊走了几个技术性硬件设备。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to land in a remote area of a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to seize several live aliens, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that may prove useful for decoding their communications and assessing their technological level, before making an escape.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

texts.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，降落在了一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。他们设法降落在了行星上的一个人迹罕至的地方，然而出人意料的是，这个行星上的居民实际上是机械体无人机。不管怎样，他们在脱逃之前以无伤条件抓捕了几个无人机，同时还顺手牵羊走了几个技术性硬件设备。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to land in a remote area of a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. Unexpectedly, it turned out that the inhabitants of the planet were, in fact, mechanical drones. Nevertheless, they seized several of them undamaged, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that may prove useful for decoding their communications and assessing their technological level, before making an escape.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

texts.zh:
一支由[This.Leader.GetName]率领的秘密行动无人机分队设法降落在了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系[abduction_planet.System.GetName]殖民地的一处人迹罕至的地带。他们很快发现这个星球上的居民实际上也是机械体无人机——或许受某个类似我方[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]的人工智能所支配。分队毫不退缩，在无伤条件下捕获了数台无人机，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件，随后成功撤离。这些或将有助于破译他们的通讯并评估其技术等级。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to land in a remote area of a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They soon discovered that the inhabitants of the world are, in fact, mechanical drones - perhaps guided by an AI like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Undeterred, they captured several drones undamaged, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that may prove useful for decoding their communications and assessing their technological level, before making an escape.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

texts.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着一艘他们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截到的货运舰船从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。舰船的船员绝大多数都保留了活口，舰船的硬件设备和电脑系统也没有遭到什么明显损坏。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with a captured cargo vessel they intercepted in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. Along with the ship's crew, which was largely taken alive, much of the vessel's hardware and computer systems were also spared major damage.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

texts.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着一艘他们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截到的货运舰船从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。出乎我们意料的是，舰船船员均由机械体无人机构成——或许由一个失控的人工智能引导——我们没法在只造成轻微伤害的情况下对其进行制服和抓捕。好在我们的小队保证了舰船的绝大多数硬件设备和电脑系统完好无损。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。
texts.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with a captured cargo vessel they intercepted in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. To our surprise, the ship was crewed exclusively by mechanical drones - perhaps guided by a rogue AI - which we were nevertheless able to disable and capture with only minor damage. Our team also managed to leave most of the vessel's hardware and computer systems intact.

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。

Though the operation went without a hitch and our operatives were able to escape without pursuit, it is probably too much to hope for that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] remain ignorant of our actions.

label.en: They shall give up their secrets.

tooltips.en: We will likely find out more from this approach, but the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] will be extremely displeased when they find out.

label.zh: 让我们把这些机械体大卸八块！

label.en: We have no need of survivors.

texts.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，还绑架了几个活的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]人质，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
texts.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized living [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] hostages, escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures they will suffer at the hands of their captors.

texts.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了我们一艘位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的货船，扣押了这艘船，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
texts.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system, seizing the ship and escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures the crew will suffer at the hands of their captors.

texts.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，然后捕获了几个[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]无人机，还有一些我们的硬件设备，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。
texts.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized several [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] drones, along with some of our hardware, escaping into the depths of space before we could send a party to destroy them. We can only hope they will be unable to find out much of value from what they have taken.

texts.zh:
我们早已怀疑允许未知外星物种进入我方宇域会带来重大风险，如今事实证明我们的担忧不无道理。[From.Owner.GetName]显然找到了隐秘登陆[abduction_planet.GetName]地表的方法，他们隔离并劫持了数名共生体后，便遁入太空深处。其行动之诡谲，令我们完全无力阻止。

对于这桩卑劣的侵犯行径，我们深感耻辱与痛惜。但值得稍感宽慰的是，这些掠夺者从窃取的样本中榨取不了多少价值。
texts.en:
We had suspected that allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and we now know we were right to be concerned. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], isolating and abducting several symbionts before fleeing into the depths of space. Such was their subterfuge, we were powerless to intervene.

We feel the shame and loss of this foul transgression, however we may also take small comfort from knowing the raiders will not glean much value from what they have stolen.

texts.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了一艘我们位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的补给舰，扣押的这艘舰船，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。
texts.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] sent a covert force to intercept one of our logistics vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system, seizing the ship and escaping into the depths of space before we could send a party to destroy them. We can only hope they will be unable to find out much of value from what they have taken.

texts.zh:
一支有勇——但或许无谋——的秘密特殊武装小队成功从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]领地撤离并从他们[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地中带走了若干人质。他们在黑夜的遮蔽下降落到行星偏远的角落并抓走了几只带有大型黑白斑点的哺乳生物，而它们并没有做出任何反抗。

不久之后我们就意识到这些生物并不能发出任何具有[This.ContactCountry.GetName]通讯的声音特征，事实上也不能给出任何证明它们是感性生物的迹象。经过进一步调查，我们得出结论，我们意外地抓获了他们牲畜的样本！

不幸的是，在这次行动之后他们的太空巡逻部队提高了警戒，说明他们已经探测到了我们的存在——使得我们任何未来的尝试计划都只能惨遭失败……
texts.en:
A brave - but perhaps not very bright - team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the planet in the cover of darkness and seize several specimens of a large, black and white speckled mammalian creature, which did not resist.

Only later did we realize that these creatures were not making any of the sounds characteristic of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions, nor indeed giving any indication whatsoever of being sentient. Upon further investigation, we concluded that we had accidentally captured examples of their livestock!

Unfortunately, their space patrols have stepped up in vigilance since the raid, indicating that they have detected our presence - making any further attempts be doomed to failure...

tooltips.zh: 我们位于他们领土的舰队开始逃脱以躲避报复打击。
tooltips.en: Our fleets in their territory have fled to avoid reprisals.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]领导的英勇的秘密特种部队试图在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的一个殖民地上登陆。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们不能指望他们有什么逃脱追捕的希望。不幸的是，我们永远没法知道他们是被留作了活口，还是在外星人手上经受长达数小时的折磨之后被处决。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we can no longer hold out any hope that they escaped capture. Unfortunately, we may never know whether they were taken alive, or whether they were spared long hours of torture at the hands of aliens by the swift release of death.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，试图降落在一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们必须假设他们要么被俘虏要么被摧毁。不幸的是，我们永远无法直到他们在永久报废之前，敌人会从他们身上榨取何等的情报。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we must assume that they were either captured or destroyed. Unfortunately, we may never know what information the enemy might have gleaned from them before their eventual demise.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]带领的隶属于秘密特种部队的英勇小队尝试在[abduction_system.GetName]星系获取一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的货船。然而他们并没有意识到他们选择的目标比预期的具有更好的武装——也没有意识到地方周边还隐藏着数艘战舰。在仓促的撤退中，他们的船只被摧毁了。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] cargo vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed along with all hands as they sought a hasty retreat.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，打算在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的补给舰。然而，他们选择的目标武装水平比先前预估的要高，他们也没有预估到周边还有几艘藏匿的战舰。无人机的舰船在仓促撤退时被摧毁。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed as they sought a hasty retreat.

tooltips.zh: 我们位于他们领土的舰队开始逃脱以躲避报复打击。
tooltips.en: Our fleets in their territory have fled to avoid reprisals.

texts.zh:
尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，打算绑架了几个人质；然而，得益于我们的早期预警系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种蠢把戏的时候会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令了结自己的生命而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这样的情况当然也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
texts.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] to attempt to seize hostages for interrogation; however, thanks to our early warning systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were under orders to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.
